content.text:
Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-105.json runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli start --case ../data/cases/dev/case-105.json --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot separates all three candidate pairs at max 4 sigma, best cursor-thrifty choice"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1

content.text: Candidate 0 vs 1 remains the live pair, slot 1 (earliest reachable) still separates it at 4σ.

content.text: Candidate 0 crossed theta (0.997) after 2 observations — per guidance, spend one confirmation observation at a high-separation slot before finalizing.

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli state --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1

content.text: Support (0.999941) is well past theta with only 2 observations — guidance calls for one confirmation observation before finalizing.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1 --slot 2 --why "Confirmation observation after crossing theta in only two measurements, earliest reachable slot, guards against a single noisy point misleading the call"

content.text: Confirmed — support unchanged and remains well above theta. Finalizing.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v2-case-105-r1 --why "Candidate 0, period 6.578 days, support 0.999941 exceeds theta 0.997 and held steady across a confirmation observation, other candidates collapsed to near zero support"

content.text: Campaign complete for **case-105**: resolved to candidate 0 (period ≈ 6.578 days), support 0.999941 ≥ theta 0.997, using 3 of 6 observations. The first two observations (earliest reachable slots) drove candidate 0's support past threshold while the other two candidates' χ² blew up (147.7 and 21.6); a third confirmation observation held the result steady before finalizing.
